name: monkemon
description: Monkemon: a 2.5D miniature toy-diorama creature-taming & real-time arena battle RPG powered by the TRELLIS.2 3D asset pipeline.

scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && for f in src/*.js src/data/*.js src/engine/*.js src/game/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && python3 -m py_compile tools/trellis_forge_server.py && echo syntax ok
